aboutTitle: What does the Broken Link Checker inspect?
about: Scan a public page and test up to 25 unique links found on it. Review reported responses and failed requests to identify links that need further checking.
example: Enter a public article URL and select Check Links. Open any reported problem link in your browser before deciding whether to update or remove it.

faqs.question: Does one scan check my entire website?
faqs.answer: No. A scan starts from the page URL you provide and tests up to 25 unique links found on that page.

faqs.question: Does a failed request always mean a broken link?
faqs.answer: No. A website may block automated requests, require a login or respond too slowly. Verify the destination before treating it as broken.
